body_markdown:
For the third consecutive year, we are proud to support Let’s Talk ADHD as a key sponsor of ADHD Awareness Week 2026!


This year’s event brought the community together in person through a family-friendly, interactive experience designed to turn awareness into real, actionable support. We are proud to back a mission centered on:


Accessible Education: Expanding public understanding with accurate, approachable information.


Practical Support: Equipping families and adults with everyday resources.


Meaningful Connection: Bridging the gap between community engagement and direct service matching.


A heartfelt thank you to the team at Let’s Talk ADHD—and to every advocate and supporter walking alongside us to champion ADHD awareness.
